mappings.applicability_reason: Operators have a documented capability to retrieve recent export files from the managed object store when customers report failed downloads [evd-006], which is an operator interface acting on customer data and matches this requirement's applicable conditions.

Operators can retrieve export files from the managed object store [evd-006], so privileged access exists; this requirement applies if that operator access crosses an untrusted network (for example, remote console or VPN), but the documentation does not state the network placement of the operator interface.
assumptions: Assuming operator access to the export retrieval mechanism may originate from outside a strictly trusted network, multi-factor authentication for those operator identities would be relevant, but no factor policy or enforcement party is described in the available documentation.

mappings.applicability_reason: Operators are described as being able to retrieve recent export files from the managed object store to assist customers with failed downloads [evd-006], which is a privileged action on customer data via an operational interface and therefore meets this requirement's applicable conditions.

Completed export files containing customer records are written to a managed object store and retained under a storage lifecycle policy [evd-003, evd-006], so the system retains customer data as a by-product of processing and intermediate artifacts are persisted, matching this requirement's applicable conditions.
assumptions: The operations guide’s description of a 30-day storage lifecycle policy for completed export files [evd-006] is taken as evidence that a concrete retention period is defined and enforced by the platform, but the conflicting architecture description of immediate deletion after customer download [evd-003] means consistency with what customers are told and the exact effective retention period cannot be verified.

documentation_gaps.title: Operator export retrieval access path and controls are not described
documentation_gaps.description: The operations guide states that operators can retrieve recent export files from the managed object store when customers report failed downloads [evd-006], but the documentation does not describe the operator access path, how access is restricted to a defined set of operators, or what audit logging is produced for each retrieval. This prevents verification of controls that would limit or detect misuse of the export-retrieval capability in the insider-misuse scenario.
documentation_gaps.importance: Without documentation of how operator access to export retrieval is authenticated, authorized, and audited, it is not possible to assess whether insider misuse of this capability is meaningfully constrained or detectable.
requested_evidence: Architecture or operations documentation describing the operator console or tooling used to retrieve exports, including how operator identities are authenticated, how access is limited to a defined set of operators (for example, roles or groups), and what audit records are written for each retrieval and where they are stored.

documentation_gaps.title: Export file retention behaviour and customer communication are unclear
documentation_gaps.description: The architecture overview describes export files in the managed object store as temporary working data that are deleted immediately once the customer has downloaded them [evd-003], while the operations guide describes a storage lifecycle policy that retains completed export files for 30 days before expiry [evd-006]. The relationship between these two behaviours and what customers are told about export-file retention is not documented, so the effective retention period relevant to operator misuse of export retrieval cannot be confirmed.
documentation_gaps.importance: The length of time export files remain in the managed object store determines the window in which an operator could misuse the retrieval capability, and inconsistency between internal descriptions and customer-facing expectations affects both exposure and correctness of data-handling assurances.
requested_evidence: Clarified documentation describing the actual retention behaviour for export files in the managed object store (including any immediate deletion after download and the 30-day lifecycle policy) and any customer-facing statements about export-file retention so that alignment between behaviour and customer commitments can be assessed.
